days.lesson: Bicameral Union: LS max 552 (530 states + 20 UT + 2 Anglo-Indian REMOVED by 104th 2020); RS max 250 (238 elected + 12 nominated). Terms: LS 5 yrs, RS perpetual 1/3 retire 2 yrs. Sessions: max 6-month gap; Budget session + Monsoon + Winter. Bills: Ordinary 107-108 (joint sitting 108: foreign-precedent? Indian joint sitting for deadlock ex money/constitutional); Money 109-110 (Speaker certifies; RS 14 days); Financial I/II; Constitutional 368 (special majority + half states for federal). Presiding: Speaker 93-96 (removal 14-day notice + effective majority), Deputy, RS Chairman VP + Deputy Chairman. Committees: PAC (22, opposition chair, CAG reports), Estimates (30 LS), Public Undertakings, JPC. Privileges 105/194: speech immunity + publication; Keshav Singh check. State: Art 168-212; creation/abolition of Legislative Council by Parliament on Assembly special-majority resolution (Art 169); AP has Council (58 members). LAW: BNSS offences against legislature privilege vs BNS; money-bill certification litigated (Aadhaar 2018 debate).

days.lesson: SC Art 124-147: 34 judges (CJI + 33), collegium (Second 1993/Third 1998) + NJAC struck (2015). HC Art 214-231: AP HC Amaravati. Jurisdiction: Original 131 (federal disputes), Writ 32 (SC:heart-soul Ambedkar; 5 writs Habeas Corpus/Mandamus/Prohibition/Certiorari/Quo Warranto) + 226 HC wider (FR + legal rights). Advisory 143. Appointment/removal: SC/HC judges removal Art 124(4) special majority + proved misbehaviour (never succeeded). CAG Art 148-151: 6 yrs/65, duties audit + PAC reports, independence (removal like SC judge). PIL: Hussainara/Khatri legal aid roots; S.P. Gupta 1981 + Bandhua Mukti epistolary jurisdiction; locus diluted for weaker sections. LAW: BNSS remand/bail reviewed via 32/226 habeas; BNS sentence vs pardon 72; BSA admissibility vs Art 20(3). AP: HC 226 review of detention/remand orders - favourite applied Q.

days.lesson: 73rd 1992 (Part IX, Sch 11, 29 subjects): 3 tiers (village/intermediate/district; <20 lakh pop may skip intermediate), direct elections, SC/ST + women 1/3 reservation (many states incl AP 50% via state law), 5-yr term, SEC + Finance Commission. 74th (Part IXA, Sch 12, 18 functions): Nagar Panchayat/Council/Corporation + wards committees + DPC/MPC. 243M: excludes Meghalaya/Mizoram/Nagaland + hill/tribal areas (protects Art 371A/G Sixth Schedule). 243N: existing laws continue 1 yr. AP: AP Panchayat Raj Act 1994; sarpanch + MPTC/ZPTC direct; 50% women quota state law; SEC conducts; Finance Commission devolution. LAW: election disputes via SEC tribunals; BNS public-election offences overlap in applied Qs.

days.lesson: Art 23: traffic/begar/forced labour banned (exception: compulsory public service without discrimination; Immoral Traffic + Bonded Labour Acts). Art 24: under-14 factory/mine/hazardous ban (M.C. Mehta). Art 25: conscience/profession/practice/propagate subject to public order/morality/health + state social-reform/temple-entry laws (Sabarimala 2018 debate). Art 26: denominations manage religious affairs/institutions/property. Art 27: no tax for religion promotion (fee for service ok). Art 28: no religious instruction in wholly state-funded schools; allowed in aided/private with consent. Art 29: minorities conserve language/script/culture + no denial of state-aided admission. Art 30: minorities establish/administer institutions (T.M.A. Pai); 30(1A) compensation on acquisition; 93rd: 15(5) skips minority. Art 32: enforcement - heart/soul; 5 writs; 32(4) no suspension ex 20-21 shield; latches? delay condonable in Epistolary? PIL link. Art 33 forces, Art 34 martial law, Art 35 Parliament alone legislates on FR punishments. LAW: BNS trafficking/bonded-labour/child-labour penal spine; BSA religious-custom proof; BNSS temple-entry order maintenance.
